instructions: This is the official character sheet for GeneFunk 2090, revised by publisher CRISPR Monkey Studios. It includes a guided character builder covering features included in the GeneFunk 2090 Core Rulebook, Shadows of Korea, and Dark Forest. It also includes drag-and-drop integration with the [GeneFunk 2090 Compendium](https://roll20.net/compendium/genefunk2090). The previous sheet remains available as GeneFunk 2090 (Legacy), so existing campaigns are unaffected.
